sources: Batch 4 kit (docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0027_tangtang.md, kit plan and "Kit (2026-10-21)"): efsim kit-draft v2 from rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0027_tangtang_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0027_tangtang_*, with the hand-written parts the report lists (Whirlpools as a layered buff, Waterspouts per Whirlpool count, the OLDEN STARE's dive branch). Values at the build's skill levels after potentials (SkillPatchTable, CharacterPotentialTable / PotentialTalentEffectTable). Verified on fixtures/zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8.json: all 46 of her logged hits.

Whirlpools (combo) are ability entities (chr_0027_tangtang_combo_skill_water, 900 frames) with buff_chr_0027_tangtang_water on Tangtang (stackingType 2, maxStackCntKey water_stack 2, 30 s per layer): kit buff `whirlpool`, one layer per Whirlpool. The battle skill wakes every Whirlpool within 50 m at frame 11 (water_wake → its jump to 1500: FinishBuff 1 layer) and its mover entity spawns 1 + n Waterspouts at frame 23 (normal_skill_abilityentitymove: water_cnt 0 → normal_skill_water_projhit, 1 → two _projhit_1, ≥ 2 → three _projhit_2). Each Waterspout ticks every 0.26 s over 90 frames (12 ticks) at tornado_atk_scale01 = passive_0's normalskill_atk_scale01 (buff_chr_0027_tangtang_passive_0: EntityBB_abilityentity_water01; P3 ×1.1).

OLDEN STARE (ultimate frame 76: entity chr_0027_tangtang_ultimate_skill_1, 210 frames): its EventListenerAction (entity frames 0–119) jumps to 128 when an operator carrying buff_chr_0027_tangtang_ultskill_buff_damage hits; buff_chr_0027_tangtang_ultskill_buff (the stare's ally aura) gives that buff on a hit by the controlled operator (CheckMainCharacterCondition) with decorate mask 1024 (a dive attack) on an enemy with _ultskill_debuff (inside the stare). Written as a hit trigger on dive landings by the controlled operator (`olden_stare_dive`); dive attacks become castable with batch-1 S10 (rotation actions): until then the branch never fires in a simulation. fixtures/zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8.json has it: Arcane's plunging_attack_end at 15374 ms, the early wave at 15558 ms, Riot Bringer Waterspouts from 15928 ms.

buffs.label: Whirlpools on the field (one layer each)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0027_tangtang_water: stackingType 2, maxStackCntKey water_stack (2, only in the buff's own blackboard: written here), duration duration_water 30 s; CreateBuff at the Whirlpool's spawn (combo_skill_water_gene, when the combo's projectile arrives), one layer removed when a Whirlpool ends (its frame 900, or a wake: frame 1500 / 1515). "Up to 2 Whirlpools can exist in the battlefield at any time": a third replaces the oldest (stackingType 2 at its maximum). Whether the game also removes the third's entity is unknown (report U1, in-game test 95).

buffs.label: Fam of Honor: Haste near a Whirlpool
buffs.note: Talent 1: "When within a 5-meter radius of a Whirlpool, allied operators gain 10% / 20% Haste … These effects persist for 3s after leaving the area of effect." The Whirlpool's AuraAction (range_talent1buff 5 m, only if talent1_speed ≥ 1) gives buff_chr_0027_tangtang_comboskill_waterbuff (SpeedupAction ratio_speed); leaving it gives _outaura (duration_talent1buff 3 s). Positions aren't modelled: the whole team counts as inside, Tangtang included (the aura's excludeOwner may exclude her: report U2, in-game test 84). Lasts the Whirlpool's 30 s + 3 s; a consumption (battle skill, Riot Bringer) cuts it to 3 s (haste_tail).

buffs.label: Fam of Honor: Haste after leaving
Waterspouts (2): Arts Susceptibility
buffs.note: buff_chr_0027_tangtang_normalskill_spellvulnerable (VulnerableAction subType 1: Arts; logged as buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_spell), created by normal_skill_water_projhit_1 with rate_spellvulnerable: stackingType 1, priority rate_spellvulnerable, maxStackCntKey cntmax, which only the buff's own blackboard has (1: the loader reads it there, batch 4 B2). The 2- and 3-Waterspout casts create the same game buff, so the kit keeps one instance across its two buffs by hand (the stack group already lets only the strongest act): the 3-Waterspout cast ends this one, and this one isn't applied over the 3-Waterspout one. Riot Bringer's Waterspouts apply it too, at the ultimate's rate_spellvulnerable + the passive's (ModifyDynamicBlackboard operation 1 at ultimate frame 76): 0 + 0.05 below P3, 0.05 + 0.05 from P3, the battle skill's own values (0.05 / 0.10) at every potential, so the battle skill's key stands for both.

buffs.label: Waterspouts (3): Arts Susceptibility
buffs.note: normal_skill_water_projhit_2's application, rate_spellvulnerable_02 (10%, 15% at P3). Riot Bringer's: the ultimate's rate_spellvulnerable_02 (0, 0.05 from P3) + the passive's (0.10): equal at every potential.

buffs.label: OLDEN STARE: a dive attack ends it
buffs.note: The window of ultimate_skill_1's EventListenerAction (entity frames 0–119, 4 s; display_duration 4 and the entity's timed marker tangtang_ult 4 s): a dive by the controlled operator now ends the stare (trigger olden_stare_dive).

buffs.label: OLDEN STARE over (dive or rogue wave)
buffs.note: Set by a dive (the entity's jump to 128: the stare's DoT ticks and the plain rogue wave still to come don't land) or by the plain rogue wave (entity frame 120, the end of the dive window). 7 s: the entity's life (ultimate_skill_1 durationFrame 210), so it covers the rest of the stare and is gone before the next ultimate (cooldown 20 s).

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When applying Cryo Infliction or dealing Arts Burst DMG to an enemy." By anyone: fixtures/zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8.json has her combo at 5137 ms as her first action, after Si's Cryo hits. An infliction that forms a reaction at once doesn't count in the engine (in-game test 35's question).
The second half of the COMBO TRIGGER: an Arts Burst of any element.

Combo frame 26: LaunchProjectile projectile_chr_0027_tangtang_water (castSkillOnReach / OnFinish / OnBlock → combo_skill_water_gene: SpawnAbilityEntity the Whirlpool + CreateBuff buff_chr_0027_tangtang_water), once per cast, only if the jet hit an enemy (CheckEntityNum tar ≥ 1: always in a simulation). The projectile's travel time isn't in the data (Ti2). Talent 1's Slow (buff_chr_0027_tangtang_comboskill_waterdebuff, SlowAction ratio_speedreduction 20% / 40%, aura 5 m, +3 s after leaving): the enemy counts as inside for the Whirlpool's 30 s + 3 s (a state for enemyControl predicates; enemy speed isn't modelled).

Battle skill frame 11: for each Whirlpool within 50 m (one enemy: all of them), water_cnt += 1 and CreateBuff buff_chr_0027_tangtang_water_wake on it (its jump to 1500 removes one buff_chr_0027_tangtang_water layer); ObtainCostAction costType 1 atb_return × 1 or × 2 by an IfElse on water_cnt, atbGainMethod 1 (returned SP; "return some SP based on the number of Waterspouts created": 20 per Whirlpool, 25 from P1). The Waterspout counts are judged at the cast, before this. The 3-Waterspout cast replaces a 2-Waterspout Susceptibility (one instance of the game buff, the stronger kept).

Ultimate frame 76: SpawnAbilityEntity chr_0027_tangtang_ultimate_skill_1, whose AuraAction (8 m, entity frames 0–120) puts buff_chr_0027_tangtang_ultskill_debuff on enemies inside: applyTags −1065936627 (Immobilization) and, unless the enemy has the control-immune tag 188749032, a layer-1 TimeDilationAction with an empty curve (scale 0) until the buff ends: the enemy's clock stops (scenario target controlImmune turns the freeze off). "applies temporary Immobilization"; display_duration 4 s. How long it really stops enemy timers: report U3, in-game test 37's variant. After a dive the entity jumps past the aura, so the game's Immobilization ends at the dive; the kit's lasts its 4 s (no action ends a control early).

hits.note: ultimate_skill_1 after the jump to 128: DamageAction atk_scale_3 ("Early Rogue Wave" 700%, ×1.15 at P5) and poise3 20 at entity frame 133, 5 frames after the dive's landing (b7b3: 184 ms). A trigger's hit: no Link of the ultimate's cast and no buff that cast consumed reaches it (the stare's ticks and the plain wave keep them).

triggers.note: A dive attack's landing (decorate bit 1024) by the controlled operator, anyone's (b7b3: Arcane's), inside the stare's window: the entity jumps to 128 (the remaining DoT ticks and the plain rogue wave don't land: olden_stare_over), the early wave 5 frames later. Talent 2 (Riot Bringer; CreateBuff buff_chr_0027_tangtang_ultskill_waterwake at 128 if talent2 ≥ 1): it wakes every Whirlpool within 50 m (water_ultskillwake → their jump to 1515, one layer each) and spawns ult_skill_abilityentitymove, whose frame 18 spawns 1 + n Waterspouts as the battle skill's mover does (n ≥ 2 → three) with talent2_ultskill 1: their damage adds dmg_up_water_ult (0.4 / 0.6, +0.8 at P5: 1.4 in b7b3) in NormalCalcZone, and they are Battle Skill DMG (mask 4352: "treated as Battle Skill DMG"; a trigger's hits with damageType battle). Their first tick inflicts Cryo (once per cast and target: the ultimate's cast is another cast than the battle skill's) and, for 2 or 3, applies the Arts Susceptibility. The Whirlpools' consumption as the battle skill's (Haste's tail, the Slow's 3 s; no SP: the ult mover has no ObtainCostAction). A rotation's dive (batch-1 S10: `plunging_attack_end` as a rotation action) sets it off.

hits.note: ObtainCostAction atb × 0.5 if controlled: atb is 0 at every level (SkillPatchTable), so no SP.

attack5_projhit: DamageAction atk_scale (mask 2097280), then if controlled a poise-only DamageAction (poise 18: "As the controlled operator, Final Strike also deals 18 Stagger"; kit-draft folds it in, D6) and, in the same branch, ObtainCostAction atb once per projectile (EntityBB_atk05_cnt).

TickIntervalAction 0.07 s over frames 3–11 (0.267 s): 4 ticks, as display_atk_scale 1.8 = 4 × 0.45 says (batch 4 D9a). A dive landing (decorate mask 1152: bit 1024), which ends an OLDEN STARE (trigger olden_stare_dive). A rotation action of the controlled operator (batch-1 S10): the landing 22 frames after the jump.
Frame 26: DamageAction atk_scale (mask 12288) and a poise-only DamageAction (poise 10; kit-draft folds it in, D6); usp once per cast (tar_cnt).

ChannelingAction frames 27–39, one target every 0.075 s, at most 5: 5 × atk_scale_1 = "Shooting DMG Multiplier" 180%, 5 × poise1 2 = "Shot Stagger" 10. buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp once (DoOnce) at the first tick.
No Whirlpool: one Waterspout (normal_skill_water_projhit). Its first tick inflicts Cryo (buff_chr_0027_tangtang_comboskill_spelllnfliction < 1 per cast and target: once).

The other ticks (every 0.26 s over 90 frames from the Waterspouts' spawn at frame 23, normal_skill_abilityentitymove's frame 12; all Waterspouts of a cast tick together): DamageAction mask 4352 (Battle Skill DMG), no infliction (the cast's marker buff_chr_0027_tangtang_comboskill_spelllnfliction is there).

One Whirlpool: two Waterspouts (_projhit_1); the first one's first tick inflicts and applies Arts Susceptibility rate_spellvulnerable (5% at level 12, +5% at P3) for duration_spellvulnerable 15 s, once per cast.

The other ticks (every 0.26 s over 90 frames from the Waterspouts' spawn at frame 23, normal_skill_abilityentitymove's frame 12; all Waterspouts of a cast tick together): DamageAction mask 4352 (Battle Skill DMG), no infliction (the cast's marker buff_chr_0027_tangtang_comboskill_spelllnfliction is there).

Two Whirlpools or more (water_cnt ≥ 2): three Waterspouts (_projhit_2); the first one's first tick inflicts (once per cast and target, as for the others) and applies Arts Susceptibility rate_spellvulnerable_02 (10%, 15% from P3) for 15 s.

The other ticks (every 0.26 s over 90 frames from the Waterspouts' spawn at frame 23, normal_skill_abilityentitymove's frame 12; all Waterspouts of a cast tick together): DamageAction mask 4352 (Battle Skill DMG), no infliction (the cast's marker buff_chr_0027_tangtang_comboskill_spelllnfliction is there).

Entity chr_0027_tangtang_ultimate_skill_1 (spawned at frame 76): ChannelingAction entity frames 0–120, one target every 0.5 s, at most 8: 8 × atk_scale_1 = "DMG Over Time Total Multiplier" 320% (×1.15 at P5). Ticks still to come when a dive ends the stare don't land (olden_stare_over; b7b3: 5 of 8).

Entity frame 120: "When the OLDEN STARE stops evolving, a rogue wave comes crashing down": atk_scale_2 400% (×1.15 at P5), poise2 15. Not after a dive (the jump to 128 skips it: the early wave instead). It closes the dive window (olden_stare_over): the EventListenerAction ends at entity frame 119.
